name: Southern Fund call for proposals (Pacific Salmon Treaty)
summary: Two-stage call from the Southern Fund Committee for projects that improve information for resource management, restore marine and freshwater habitat, or enhance wild salmon stocks with low-technology techniques.

eligibility.rule: Previous Southern Fund recipients must be in good standing at Stage Two
Not a core or ongoing management agency activity, except in extraordinary circumstances
Wild-stock enhancement does not involve high-cost, capital-intensive projects such as traditional hatcheries
If invited to Stage Two, submit overdue Southern Fund reports by the detailed proposal deadline

status.quote: The deadline for concept submissions closed on August 19, 2026.

deadline.quote: The deadline for concept submissions closed on August 19, 2026.

status.quote: Applications for 2028 will open in June 2027.

applicant_types.quote: Applications are welcome from private, non-profit, and public sector organizations.

access.quote: The Pacific Salmon Commission's Southern Fund Committee (SFC) has issued its 2027 Call for Proposals and is now accepting project concepts for the 2027 funding cycle

window.quote: The deadline for concept submissions closed on August 19, 2026. Applications for 2028 will open in June 2027.

effort.quote: The deadline to submit a project concept is by 11:59 p.m. (PT) on Wednesday, August 19, 2026.
The first-round review of all Project Concepts will take place in September 2026.
The deadline to submit a detailed proposal is 11:59pm PCT on Wednesday November 18, 2026.
The detailed proposals will be subject to an in-depth technical review.

eligibility.quote: must be in good standing at the Stage Two (Detailed Proposal) round to remain eligible
The Committee will not provide funding to support core or ongoing activities that are normally management agency responsibilities, except under extraordinary circumstances.
High cost, capital-intensive projects (e.g., traditional hatchery facilities) will not be considered by the Committee.

If a Project Concept is received and (a) the application is for an ongoing Southern Fund project that has overdue reports, or (b) the lead proponent has previously received Southern Fund support for any project with outstanding reports, and if a proponent is invited to submit a Detailed Proposal, overdue reports require submission by the Detailed Proposal submission deadline.

after_award.quote: Also, by staff assessment of interim and final reports to evaluate compliance performance on the part of project proponents.
